name: After § 116
title: REPORT on the EU strategy for the rights of persons with disabilities post-2024
part_text: 116b. Calls on the Commission, in cooperation with Parliament’s Committee on Petitions, to publish an annual report summarising trends, issues and follow-up actions related to disability-focused petitions submitted to Parliament, such that this report should feed into the mid-term and final evaluations of the EU strategy for the rights of persons with disabilities;
